'Poet of the Millennium' belongs to Gurram Jashuva (Wikipedia), Kavi Samrat to Viswanatha, Yuga Kavi to Seshendra Sarma and Navayuga Kavi Chakravarti to Jashuva – none of the printed titles is Sri Sri's; his title is Mahakavi.

NextGen and most exam keys give Mogallu (Moggallu), West Godavari, as Alluri's birthplace; Pandrangi near Vizianagaram is given in other accounts. Koyyuru is where he was shot and Krishnadevipeta his tomb.
